standard.coverage: Employers with FOUR OR MORE employees (Ark. Code 11-4-203 and 11-4-210). An Arkansas employer with three employees owes only whatever the FLSA requires of it.
standard.note: Final step of 2018 Issue 5 ($9.25 in 2019, $10.00 in 2020, $11.00 in 2021). No indexation -- Arkansas has been flat since 2021.

tipped.note: Arkansas's cash wage of $2.63 is fixed by rule; the tip credit therefore absorbs every increase in the standard rate.

youthAndTraining.label: Federal youth opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 consecutive calendar days -- 29 U.S.C. 206(g). Not a state figure; carried here because it is the only sub-minimum wage available in this state.
